content.text: Home / WILD GAME We offer a full selection of wild game. Game covers a wide and diverse range of animals and birds, naturalised or born in the wild, all sourced from selected estates in Scotland and Northern England. We produce high quality, oven-ready game, using another local family firm, who process the... meat to match our own exacting standards. Grouse is our speciality which can be purchased individually or as a bulk buy Young Grouse box which includes free delivery. It is harvested from the heather hills in summer and early autumn, where it lives wild on well managed estates. Taste it and witness one of Britain’s most extraordinary foods; deliciously lean meat with a rich and herby taste, so good with vintage claret. Later in the autumn we have an abundant supply of pheasant and partridge – nutritious and flavoursome alternatives to bland poultry. These and other game birds are sold plucked, dressed and ready to cook. If you are new to cooking game, we are happy to advise you and give cooking instructions. You may wish to have a look at some of our favourite recipes here. All game birds are despatched in cool boxes, plucked and dressed and vacuum packed. All game is wild and therefore supply can be unpredictable — the dates of availability are within the season limits of each species because this is when we are most likely to have the birds fresh and at their best. Contact us if you would like partridge, pheasant, mallard, wigeon, woodpigeon, hare, wild rabbit, snipe, pintail or any other species. Main Game season for birds is September to January, outside of the season we do have limited frozen quantities please ask. We offer all of our game birds as individual products but we also have pre-selected Wild Game Boxes which contain a mixture of game species and some contain multiple pack bulk buys ideal for stocking up your freezer and offer great value for money. Please note – all game may contain shot.[ read more ]
